Build a complete, modern music streaming application called “Blue Berry”, inspired by premium music apps but with completely original branding and UI.

🎵 APP NAME

Blue Berry

🫐 VISUAL THEME

Use a beautiful blueberry-inspired dark theme throughout the entire application.

Background

- Very dark navy/blue background
- Subtle blueberry-inspired gradient
- Add a soft, abstract blueberry texture/pattern in the background
- Use subtle blueberry shapes/blobs and glowing particles
- Keep the background elegant and non-distracting
- Do NOT use copyrighted Spotify assets or branding

Color palette

- Deep navy
- Blueberry blue
- Electric blue highlights
- Soft purple-blue accents
- White/light-gray text

The overall appearance should feel premium, modern, smooth and futuristic.

🏠 HOME

Create:

- Blue Berry logo/name
- Featured songs
- Trending music
- Recommended songs
- Recently played
- Popular artists
- Albums
- Genre categories

Use beautiful album artwork cards with rounded corners.

🔎 SEARCH

Allow users to search:

- Songs
- Artists
- Albums
- Genres

Each result should show:

- Artwork
- Song name
- Artist
- Duration
- Play button
- Favourite button
- Download button where legally permitted

🎧 MUSIC PLAYER

Create a persistent mini-player at the bottom.

Full-screen player should contain:

- Large album artwork
- Song title
- Artist
- Progress bar
- Current time / duration
- Previous
- Play/Pause
- Next
- Shuffle
- Repeat
- Favourite
- Download
- Queue
- Volume

Use smooth animations and blueberry-blue visual effects.

❤️ FAVOURITES

Create a Liked Songs section.

Users can:

- Like/unlike songs
- View all liked songs
- Play all
- Shuffle
- Remove songs

Save favourites permanently using local storage/database.

⬇️ DOWNLOADS

Create a dedicated Downloads section.

Only allow downloading when the selected music provider legally permits downloading.

Features:

- Download progress
- Pause/resume
- Cancel
- Delete
- File size
- Offline playback

Downloaded songs must remain playable without internet.

📚 LIBRARY

Create:

- Liked Songs
- Playlists
- Downloads
- Recently Played

🎶 PLAYLISTS

Users can:

- Create playlists
- Rename playlists
- Delete playlists
- Add songs
- Remove songs
- Play playlist
- Shuffle playlist

🕘 RECENTLY PLAYED

Store the user's recently played songs locally.

Show the latest 20–50 tracks.

🌐 MUSIC API

Use a FREE and LEGAL music API/source.

The API must legally allow the functionality being implemented.

Do NOT:

- Bypass DRM
- Scrape unauthorized music
- Circumvent copyright restrictions
- Use unauthorized downloading methods
- Pretend that preview URLs are full songs

If one API cannot provide full-length legal streaming, use another legal/free source where available.

Create a provider-independent API layer with:

- "searchTracks()"
- "getTrendingTracks()"
- "getFeaturedTracks()"
- "getTrack()"
- "getArtist()"
- "getAlbum()"
- "getStreamUrl()"
- "getDownloadUrl()" — only when legally permitted

Keep API keys in environment variables and never expose private keys in frontend code.

🎵 AUDIO

Support:

- Full-length legally available tracks
- Background playback where supported
- Media notification controls
- Lock-screen controls where supported
- Resume playback
- Queue
- Automatic next-song playback
- Buffering/loading states
- Network error handling

💾 STORAGE

Persist:

- Favourites
- Playlists
- Downloads metadata
- Recently played
- User settings
- Playback state

📱 NAVIGATION

Bottom navigation:

Home | Search | Library | Downloads

Use clean icons and smooth transitions.

⚙️ SETTINGS

Include:

- Dark/light mode
- Audio quality
- Wi-Fi-only downloads
- Clear cache
- Clear recently played
- Storage usage
- About Blue Berry
- Privacy
- Music source/API information

✨ UI DETAILS

Add:

- Smooth page transitions
- Glassmorphism where appropriate
- Rounded cards
- Blueberry-blue glow effects
- Subtle animations
- Skeleton loaders
- Empty states
- Error states
- Offline indicator
- Toast/snackbar notifications
- Responsive design

Do not make the interface overly flashy. Keep it clean and premium.

🚀 PERFORMANCE

Optimize for:

- Fast startup
- Lazy-loaded artwork
- Image caching
- API caching
- Efficient audio streaming
- Efficient downloads
- Low memory usage
- Slow internet connections

🔐 SECURITY

- Never hardcode private API keys
- Use environment variables
- Validate API responses
- Sanitize search input
- Handle API failures
- Do not bypass DRM or copyright restrictions

🏗️ CODE QUALITY

Use:

- Clean architecture
- Reusable components
- Modular services
- Proper error handling
- Maintainable folder structure
- Production-quality code

Before implementation, inspect the selected music API's current terms and capabilities and verify which tracks/features can legally be streamed or downloaded.

If full-song streaming or downloading is not legally available from the selected free API, clearly handle that limitation rather than implementing unauthorized access.

🫐 BRANDING

The application should consistently use the Blue Berry identity.

Create an original Blue Berry logo/icon using a stylized blueberry-inspired design.

The final application should feel like a premium blueberry-themed music streaming platform with:

✓ Full legal song playback
✓ Search
✓ Recommendations
✓ Favourites
✓ Playlists
✓ Recently Played
✓ Downloads where legally permitted
✓ Offline playback
✓ Persistent library
✓ Modern blueberry background
✓ Premium music player
✓ Smooth animations
✓ Free/legal music API integration
